One line in the log per texture says the one thing an application cannot see otherwise: the texture's pixels are the texture's own and not the heap's bytes, because an ES 2.0 texture is copied into and cannot be backed by memory the heap hands out (facts/Metal/Heaps.md names what a native fix would be)
